papers.title: Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction
papers.abstract: Long video generation should keep the subject and background consistent while supporting rich, natural motion. However, autoregressive models are often distilled with distribution matching distillation (DMD) over short windows, which does not train them to keep this consistency over long ranges. As a result, the subject and background can drift over time. Methods that manage the key-value (KV) cache retain or retrieve history to reduce drift. Yet this history may itself have drifted. We propose Reference Forcing, which uses the initial frames as an appearance reference. We first build a teacher that uses attention masks to force each region of a new frame to attend to the same region in the initial frames. The teacher finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation models. We then distill this behavior into a separate attention path of the student, which needs no external models at inference. We further introduce value correction, which corrects drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of drift-free initial frames. Experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency among long-video methods on different base models, and its advantage grows with video length. Ablations show both components are needed to gain consistency without losing motion. More visualizations and code are available at https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对自回归长视频生成中主体与背景随时间漂移的问题，提出Reference Forcing。该方法以初始视频块作为无漂移的外观参考，通过独立的锚点注意力路径让当前内容匹配初始帧中的对应区域，并利用训练得到的锚点门控控制不同内容使用参考的强度；同时，通过值校正修复近期KV缓存中的漂移值。教师模型使用主体分割和光流构造区域掩码，学生模型通过LoRA和门控蒸馏教师行为，从而在推理时不依赖外部模型。实验在LongLive和Self-Forcing等基础模型上表明，该方法显著提升长时主体和背景一致性，同时基本保持运动能力；但更强的参考约束会带来运动减弱甚至场景冻结。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出区域引导蒸馏方法：教师模型借助主体分割和背景光流，使当前帧区域关注初始帧中的对应区域，并将该行为蒸馏到学生模型的独立锚点注意力路径中。2. 引入学习得到的锚点门控，使初始帧中已有的主体和背景使用参考信息，而后续新出现的内容减少或关闭参考路径。3. 提出无需训练的值校正机制，通过键相似度匹配，将近期KV缓存中的漂移值向初始帧对应值插值修正，同时保留原有键。4. 通过在LongLive和Self-Forcing上的实验、长时评测、用户研究及消融实验，证明该方法能提高主体和背景一致性，并在较少牺牲运动的情况下延缓长视频中的外观漂移。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作直接对应长视频生成、自回归视频扩散、因果生成和KV缓存复用等研究方向。它针对逐块生成中的误差累积，利用初始帧参考和缓存值修复稳定长时间生成；独立锚点注意力避免在同一softmax中以牺牲近期运动上下文换取一致性。方法建立在少步蒸馏的自回归视频模型上，并能生成分钟级乃至论文展示的两小时视频，因此与长视频生成和实时生成具有直接关系。其训练阶段使用外部分割与光流教师，但蒸馏后推理无需这些模型，减少了推理依赖。论文没有涉及动作条件控制、闭环视觉世界模型或稀疏注意力本身，但其缓存复用、因果生成和长时漂移校正对这些方向具有参考价值。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出：该方法只使用初始视频块作为参考，因此后续才出现的内容（例如进入场景的物体）没有对应参考；动态更新参考信息留待未来工作。锚点路径会对初始帧中的匹配区域进行平均，可能轻微平滑细节纹理，因此成像质量略低于LongLive。包含多个相似主体的场景仍较难处理，因为教师使用的分割流程只跟踪单个主体。教师还依赖检测器在初始块中寻找主体；若检测不到主体，就会把整帧视为背景并使用光流匹配，这种情况主要出现在风景或人群等没有明确主要主体的场景。提高锚点路径强度还会降低运动，过高时可能使场景接近冻结。
papers.abstract_cn: 长视频生成应在支持丰富、自然运动的同时，保持主体和背景的一致性。然而，自回归模型通常使用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）在短窗口上进行蒸馏，这并不能训练模型在长时间范围内保持这种一致性。因此，主体和背景会随着时间发生漂移。管理键值（KV）缓存的方法会保留或检索历史信息，以减少漂移，但这些历史信息本身可能已经发生漂移。我们提出 Reference Forcing，利用初始帧作为外观参考。首先，我们构建一个教师模型，使用注意力掩码，强制新帧中的每个区域关注初始帧中的对应区域。教师模型借助现成的分割模型寻找这些区域。随后，我们将这种行为蒸馏到学生模型的一条独立注意力路径中，使其在推理时无需外部模型。我们进一步提出值校正，将KV缓存中已经漂移的值向无漂移初始帧中的匹配值进行校正。实验表明，在不同基础模型上的长视频方法中，Reference Forcing在主体和背景一致性方面达到最先进水平，并且其优势会随着视频长度增加而扩大。消融实验表明，两个组件都是在不牺牲运动的情况下提升一致性所必需的。更多可视化结果和代码见 https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/。

papers.title: SAFER: Navigating the Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma in World-Model-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website.
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究依赖世界模型进行自动驾驶规划时的探索—利用困境：模型在训练数据覆盖范围内较可靠，但规划器若探索覆盖范围之外的动作，模型误差会使其偏好被高估的危险动作。SAFER 通过“阶段化失败—专家标注—世界模型规划—在线适应”解决这一问题。离线阶段利用较弱策略、动作噪声和可恢复的延迟制动或保持制动扰动制造失败，并记录真实后果及专家动作和值；模型采用分块式因果潜在动力学，一次预测 1.6 秒未来，同时预测奖励、价值、持续性和碰撞风险。规划阶段使用风险感知 MPPI，在预测回报中加入有界碰撞惩罚；在线阶段利用自身驾驶数据更新动力学、奖励和风险模块，并用指数滑动平均参数稳定规划目标。CARLA 和 MetaDrive 的闭环实验表明，风险项、在线适应和针对性数据扩展均能提升安全性与整体驾驶表现，但在线适应主要改善其实际驾驶过的环境。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 形式化了自动驾驶世界模型规划中的探索—利用困境，分析模型误差如何导致规划器偏好模型高估的候选动作，并给出相应的选择偏差与遗憾界限。 2. 提出由较弱驾驶策略和脚本化可恢复扰动生成失败数据、再由专家为每个访问状态标注动作和值的数据构建方法，使模型同时学习错误的后果和正确的恢复方式。 3. 构建分块式潜在世界模型，以因果掩码在一次前向传播中预测整段未来，并结合奖励因素、持续性、价值集成和行为克隆动作先验。 4. 提出专门的累积碰撞风险头，并加入“制动越强、预测风险不应升高”的单调性约束；结合风险惩罚的 MPPI 规划器在单 GPU 上实时运行。 5. 提出在线适应规则，同时更新动力学、奖励评分器和风险头，冻结依赖专家标签的动作先验与价值集成，并使用 EMA 目标稳定规划。 6. 在 CARLA 和 MetaDrive/CAT 上进行闭环消融、基线比较和数据飞轮实验，验证各模块对路线完成率、回报和安全性的影响。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点高度相关。它直接研究基于世界模型的闭环规划和行动条件的视觉环境预测：候选动作序列被输入分块式潜在动力学模型，模型以因果掩码预测对应的未来潜状态，因此兼具行动条件、因果和近似自回归语义。一次前向传播预测 16 步未来，减少逐步滚动的计算成本，服务于 10 Hz 实时规划；MPPI 通过采样候选动作并反复重规划实现闭环控制。在线模型更新、风险预测和 EMA 缓存式目标更新也与持续适应、缓存稳定和实时生成相关。不过，论文的核心应用是自动驾驶决策世界模型，而非通用视频生成；其观测主要是特权 BEV 或低维状态，并未展示 RGB 视频生成、视频扩散、长视频生成或显式的视频 token 缓存复用。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文的实验主要在 CARLA 和 MetaDrive 仿真器中进行，且 CARLA 使用特权鸟瞰图和自车状态输入，不能直接代表真实摄像头感知或真实道路部署。离线失败由较弱策略、噪声和脚本化扰动产生，其中脚本化失败被设计为可恢复，失败分布可能无法覆盖真实驾驶中的全部危险情形。在线适应需要在目标环境中持续收集交互数据，且主要改善规划器实际驾驶过的环境；在未参与在线驾驶的城镇中，论文观察到性能没有明显提升。模型只预测 1.6 秒的显式未来，较长期后果依赖价值头进行自举，因此其长期预测能力仍受价值估计和模型误差影响。风险项和在线适应会带来更谨慎或更易被阻塞的行为，数据飞轮实验中阻塞率上升、路线完成率下降。SAFER 在部分指标上并非所有基线中最优，例如 CARLA 驾驶总分略低于 DreamerV3，且行人碰撞仍高于部分基线。真实世界迁移成本、传感器噪声下的表现以及对专家质量和专家查询能力的依赖，论文未明确说明。
papers.abstract_cn: 自动驾驶车辆必须预见其行动的后果，尤其是在发生碰撞的罕见且时间紧迫的情境中。世界模型能够提供这种预见能力，但其能力仅限于训练数据的覆盖范围，由此产生了探索—利用困境。在覆盖范围内，规划器几乎难以超越数据本身；而一旦超出该范围，模型误差就会误导规划器。高水平驾驶日志很少包含能够扩大覆盖范围的失败，而通过交互学习的智能体只能通过自身失败获得这些经验，却不会同时得到应当如何应对的示范。我们提出 SAFER，一种从他人造成、经专家评判的失败中进行离线学习，并持续从自身驾驶中在线学习的框架。离线阶段，让部分训练的智能体和脚本化的可恢复扰动在仿真中制造失败；专家为每个访问状态标注应采取的动作及其价值，从而使规划器探索的大量状态在实际驾驶前就已被覆盖。在规划阶段，分块式潜在世界模型能够足够快速地预测后果，以满足实时使用需求；风险感知的基于采样的规划器则以回报减去有界碰撞惩罚来评估候选机动。在线阶段，一个闭环过程会在驾驶超出离线数据覆盖范围的地方持续细化模型。在与对比方法进行闭环评估时，SAFER 在 CARLA Leaderboard 路线上取得了最高的路线完成率和每步回报；从特权鸟瞰图输入出发，这两项指标分别为 0.95 和 0.77；在 MetaDrive 中，它在常规交通和安全关键交通下分别取得最高的回合回报 53.4 和 49.0。项目主页：https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website。

papers.title: SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?
papers.abstract: While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.
papers.comment: Preprint. Benchmark paper with paired scientific experiments for evaluating video world models. 8 pages of main text, 16 pages including figures and references
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 SciWorldBench，用222对、覆盖八个科学类别的成对实验评估视频世界模型是否能根据单一条件变化生成相应的不同结果。每对实验固定场景、过程和摄像机设置，仅改变一个条件；提示词不给出结果，VLM在不知道条件和正确标签的情况下独立评估视频。对十个TI2V模型的评测显示，成对准确率仅为1.4%至24.8%，模型常在两种条件下生成相同结果；即使明确提供结果，最高成对准确率也只有33.3%。文本中能够正确预测结果并不意味着能在视频中正确呈现，说明当前模型更依赖视觉先验进行渲染，而非可靠模拟条件驱动的科学因果过程。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出SciWorldBench：包含222对实验、八个科学类别，每对实验只改变一个条件并具有相互排斥且可视觉验证的结果。 2. 设计成对评估协议，分别检查视频是否满足实验前提、呈现目标结果并排除另一结果；引入前提通过率（PPR）、科学结果准确率（SOA）、成对准确率（PA）和坍缩率（CR）等指标。 3. 使用不接触条件文本和正确结果标签的独立VLM评估视频，并通过人工共识验证判断。 4. 评测十个主流TI2V模型，揭示其在条件变化下重复生成相同结果的普遍现象，以及文本推理能力与视频生成能力之间的明显差距。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文直接针对视频生成和视频世界模型的科学物理一致性与条件—结果因果理解。其成对实验设置检验模型是否能响应单一条件变化，而不是仅凭场景外观和视觉先验生成熟悉结果，适用于评估闭环模拟所需的状态转移和因果预测能力。研究聚焦TI2V生成，未涉及自回归、因果流式生成、长视频、实时生成、蒸馏、稀疏注意力或缓存复用等效率和架构技术，但其发现对构建可靠的物理世界模拟器和动作/条件驱动视频生成模型具有直接启发意义。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出两点限制：第一，对模型机制的解释主要来自行为输出和文本预测，没有探查内部表征，因此导致这些现象的深层机制仍有待研究；第二，评估结果高度依赖VLM裁判，即使使用先进模型，其与人工标注者的一致性仍不完美，可能引入评分误差。除此之外，论文未明确说明该基准对更长时长、真实闭环交互、动作条件控制或实时生成场景的覆盖程度。
papers.abstract_cn: 尽管视频生成模型准确呈现科学现象的能力日益受到关注，但如何确定这些模型是否真正理解其 underlying 原理，仍是一个关键挑战。现有基准通常孤立地评估视频样本，因此难以揭示仅仅拟合表层视觉先验的模型。在科学实验中，即使其余设置保持不变，条件发生微小变化也会产生显著不同的结果。基于这种敏感性，我们提出 SciWorldBench，这是一个由成对科学实验组成的基准。每一对实验在其他设置固定的情况下改变一个条件，从而产生两个相互排斥的预期结果。每个生成提示词指定实验条件，但省略预期结果。我们使用一个独立的视觉语言模型（VLM）评估十个文本与图像到视频（TI2V）模型；该 VLM 评估每个视频时无法看到条件文本，也无法看到标识正确结果的标签。只有当一对视频都呈现各自科学上正确的结果时，该实验对才被判定为正确。在全部十个模型中，我们发现，尽管不同条件要求不同结果，但同一实验对中的两个视频经常呈现相同的结果。这种反复出现的失败表明，当前视频世界模型在生成过程中难以可靠地运用潜在的科学原理。我们将公开发布该基准数据集并开源评估代码。

papers.title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
papers.abstract: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.
papers.summary_cn: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs.
papers.contribution_cn: To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：efficient generation, streaming video；关键词：streaming, few-step, distillation, cache, efficient, video generation
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: ScoutCache: Efficient Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Conditional Readout and Selective Caching
papers.abstract: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient long video generation, but inference still incurs substantial computational costs from repeated denoising and KV cache operations. Existing acceleration methods reduce parts of this overhead, while historical KV reading and cache construction remain costly across video chunks. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutCache, a training-free framework that jointly optimizes denoising, historical KV reading, and cache construction. We observe that shallow feature changes provide useful information for estimating clean latent updates, while historical KV dependence varies across Transformer layers and attention heads but remains relatively stable across video chunks. Based on these observations, we develop Conditional Denoising Readout (CDR) to estimate intermediate denoising updates from shallow feature changes and known noise variations. We further introduce Output Risk Guided Historical KV Reading (ORHR) to allocate historical reading budgets based on attention output perturbations, and Content and Coverage Guided Sparse Cache Construction (CCSC) to reduce cache construction costs by selecting informative spatial tokens while maintaining spatial coverage. Extensive experiments on Self-Forcing and LongLive using VBench and MovieGen demonstrate that ScoutCache achieves up to 2.28$\times$ and 1.86$\times$ speedups, respectively, while consistently improving generation quality without modifying pretrained model parameters.
papers.summary_cn: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient long video generation, but inference still incurs substantial computational costs from repeated denoising and KV cache operations.

papers.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
papers.abstract: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

papers.title: A Unified Control Framework, Mathematical Model, and Five-layer Closed-loop Case Study for Embodied Intelligence Control Systems
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence holds that an agent develops cognition and behavior through real-time body-environment interaction, so its control system must tightly couple perception, decision making, learning, optimization, constraints, and physical execution. This report asks whether a unified framework exists, how its mathematical models unify, and how the framework is realized computably. Four conclusions emerge. (1) No single framework is accepted, but the field converges on a common skeleton: from operational-space and whole-body control to MPC, reinforcement learning, active inference, and diffusion/flow policies, all reduce to constrained sequential decision making on the configuration manifold. (2) Two languages describe it-deterministic optimal control (Euler-Lagrange plus constrained OCP, reduced in real time to a QP) and probabilistic inference (MDP/POMDP plus free-energy minimization)-rigorously bridged by control as inference and KL/path-integral control. (3) Engineering unification is already achieved by constrained optimization; the new frontier is cross-morphology, cross-task shared representation. (4) The hardest gap is provable stability and safety, the entry point for spectral, geometric, differentiable-optimization, and safe-learning methods. A single-link manipulator then runs through all five layers: L4 parses the instruction into a reference, L3 identifies a Koopman lifted linear world model, L2 solves a receding constrained QP, L1 adds torque saturation and a CBF, and L0 is the true nonlinear plant. Closed-loop tracking RMSE is 0.0218 rad with all constraints satisfied and a world-model error near 5 x 10^-6 rad, reported with curves and a 3D animation.

papers.title: ActWorld-JEPA: Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models Meet Latent Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable future prediction in latent space without pixel reconstruction. However, latent predictive consistency alone does not establish the relative driving quality of candidate plans. We present ActWorld-JEPA, a joint-embedding formulation for candidate-based driving. Where Plan-Conditioned JEPA (PC-JEPA) uses global and step-wise trajectory intentions to guide recurrent latent prediction, then combines the predicted future with the current scene through gated cross-attention; Relational Residual Reranking ($R^3$) models agreement and discrepancy between plan and future representations under planning supervision, yielding bounded, gated residual corrections to the base planning scores. This formulation connects latent prediction to candidate selection using only observed context and proposed trajectories at inference. Benchmark-specific implementations report 94.1 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, with the final selector calibrated using aggregate NAVTEST feedback, and 91.6 and 42.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, respectively. The nuScenes evaluation reports a mean $L_2$ error of 1.20 m and a predicted collision rate of 0.76% over 1--6 s. This work provides an effective path from JEPA's predictive representations to driving decisions informed by anticipated consequences.

papers.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

papers.title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
papers.abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
